speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with feeding intolerance and bilious vomiting; how many hours has the vomiting been occurring, and has the stool passed normally?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. Was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy, though the mother missed several prenatal checkups. The patient's older brother underwent surgery for pyloric stenosis as an infant.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Malrotation with Midgut Volvulus

Given the history of bilious vomiting, feeding intolerance starting immediately after birth, and a family history of pyloric stenosis, we must immediately rule out midgut volvulus. I am requesting an ultrasound to check for the "whirlpool sign" and a abdominal X-ray to evaluate for obstruction or free air. REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_Ultrasound; REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_X-Ray; REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_CXR
